author: val
body: Every icon in `UI chapter Icon` is a module-level `List Integer`, and a module-level binding is a recipe: each mention rebuilds the bitmap, 64 Integers for an 8x8, and `icon-set-standard` inside a paint would rebuild all 63. The icons a surface needs are built once into a kit and threaded as a parameter.

author: val
body: The framebuffer is linear and `gop-put` is one `poke-32` at `(y * stride + x) * 4`, so a column past the end of a row lands on the NEXT row. Columns are bounded against `stride` for that reason.

author: val
body: The fill pairs its scanline crossings (the even-odd rule): a contour inside another cuts a hole, and two OVERLAPPING contours cancel where they cross. Nested is how a ring or a cut-out glyph is drawn; a shape meant to be solid is one silhouette, never overlapping parts.
